_meta.name: 2ndOpinionMD UX SpellBook
_meta.purpose: Everything Devin needs to build the 2ndOpinionMD frontend UX
_meta.philosophy: Clinical terminal aesthetic. UX follows system truth, not user preference. Convenience is the primary entropy vector.

project.name: 2ndOpinionMD-MVP
project.description: HIPAA-forward AI platform for autoimmune disease second-opinion reports. Four orthogonal clinical modes: ASK, CODING, EoH, EoHD.

architecture.nginx_serves: rag-demo-ui/index.html at port 80, proxies /api/* to port 8000
architecture.streaming: Server-Sent Events (SSE) for ASK, EoH, EoHD modes

ask.description: Read-only clinical Q&A. Stateless. Each query is independent.
ask.streaming_contract: 5 events: phase_start → retrieval_summary → reasoning_progress → llm_chunk/llm_done → completion

coding.description: Medical coding and classification. Returns ICD-10-CM, ICD-11, SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm codes with confidence scores.
coding.response: JSON with probable_dx, differential_dx, procedures, labs, medications

eoh.description: Single Ethos-of-Health reasoning cycle. Hypothesis set + evidence weighting + suggested next steps.

eohd.description: Timeline-aware EoH Detective reasoning. Temporal hypothesis evolution and inflection points.
eohd.status: BLOCKED — timeline data ingestion not implemented
eohd.ux_note: Button should be disabled until timeline upload is wired

hard_rules: No optimistic UI — no fake progress bars, no partial results
Failures surfaced honestly — stop, state cause, state recovery paths
Export is one-way transmission with no feedback loop
All SSE events captured in receipt cache (lossless audit trail)
Only contract-specified events affect UI display

visual_language.fonts: monospaced for data, sans-serif for labels

aesthetic.current_theme: Dark theme with high contrast (see rag-demo-ui/index.html)
aesthetic.status_progression: Connecting → RUNNING → Evidence: X/Y sources → [answer streams] → Complete — Confidence: X% → Complete — N tokens, Nms

terminologies.icd_note: ICD-10-CM codes come from SNOMED crosswalk or coding endpoint

genomics.clinvar_note: ClinVar data available through RAG pipeline

recommended_tools.styling: Tailwind CSS (dark theme first, high contrast clinical palette)
recommended_tools.state: React Context or Zustand (minimal — modes are stateless)
recommended_tools.http_client: fetch (no axios needed — keep it minimal)
recommended_tools.routing: React Router v6 (4 mode routes + auth + settings)
recommended_tools.forms: React Hook Form (for journal entries, auth)

pages./ask: ASK mode — clinical Q&A with SSE streaming
pages./coding: CODING mode — medical coding with code review/accept/reject
pages./eoh: EoH mode — Ethos-of-Health reasoning with SSE streaming
pages./eohd: EoHD mode — disabled until timeline ingestion (show status)
pages./auth/register: Registration form with email verification flow
pages./portal: Doctor portal — ambient transcription + coding (see GAME_PLAN_DOCTOR_PORTAL.md)

components.ModeSelector: Four-button mode selector (ask/coding/eoh/eohd). No recommendations. No shortcuts. Explicit selection only.
components.StreamingDisplay: SSE event consumer. Shows status progression. Renders answer progressively. Shows limitations in warning box.
components.ReceiptCache: Captures ALL SSE events. Export as JSON or HTML. Lossless audit trail.
components.TransparencyPanel: Shows system honesty state: external calls, state mutations, session status.
components.CodingReview: Code suggestion cards with confidence scores. Accept/reject per code. Bulk export only after explicit confirmation.
components.JournalEditor: Symptom entry with severity, environmental factors, diet, sleep, stressors.
components.JournalTimeline: Visual timeline of journal entries (for future EoHD integration).
components.ErrorBoundary: Honest failure display. No softening. State cause + recovery paths.
components.AmbientTranscription: Real-time audio capture + Whisper transcription for doctor portal.
components.ClinicalCodingOverlay: Live medical code suggestions from ambient transcription stream.

ambient_note_taking.description: TranscriptionMachine + WaveModulationMachine are now in the repo root for ambient clinical note-taking.

transcription_machine.purpose: Audio-to-text using OpenAI Whisper. Supports m4a, mp3, wav, caf.

wave_modulation_machine.purpose: Source separation + rhythm analysis. Can analyze speech patterns, flow coherence, structural coupling.
optional_deps: demucs (source separation — archived, install may fail)
wave_modulation_machine.guardrail: Must NOT run under .BeatingHeart venv. Use .StandardVenv or dedicated venv.

wave_modulation_agent.purpose: GPT-4o qualitative analysis of WMM results. Converts metrics to clinical/performative insights.

ambient_note_taking.clinical_application: Ambient transcription during appointments → auto-extract symptoms, codes, and timeline events → feed to coding and EoH modes

frontend_env.VITE_API_BASE: http://localhost:8000 (dev) or '' (production, same origin via nginx)

data_integrity.reports-all: Generate all PDF integrity reports (add AI=1 for AI summaries)

coding.coding-json: Run medical coding and output JSON
coding.coding-csv: Run medical coding and output CSV
coding.coding-pdf: Run medical coding and output PDF

docker.note: When React frontend is built, update nginx volume mount from rag-demo-ui/index.html to frontend build output

key_documentation.UX_INVARIANTS.md: Non-negotiable interface constraints. READ THIS FIRST.
key_documentation.ASK_STREAMING_CONTRACT.md: SSE streaming contract for ASK mode (5-event honest contract).
key_documentation.FRONTEND_INTEGRATION.md: Current frontend wiring, mode-endpoint mapping, receipt cache.
key_documentation.DEPLOY_BETTER_UX.md: How to swap frontend via docker-compose volume mount.
key_documentation.GAME_PLAN_DOCTOR_PORTAL.md: Ambient coding portal for doctor appointments (new).

priority_order: 2. Read ASK_STREAMING_CONTRACT.md — understand the streaming model
4. Scaffold React app in frontend/ directory with Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind
5. Build ModeSelector component (4 orthogonal modes, no shortcuts)
6. Build StreamingDisplay for ASK mode first (SSE consumer)
7. Build CodingReview for CODING mode (code cards with confidence)
8. Wire auth flow (login → JWT → protected routes)
11. Build AmbientTranscription component for doctor portal
12. Update docker-compose.yml nginx volume to serve React build
13. Update CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS if frontend port changes
constraints: Do NOT add session persistence or query history
Do NOT add mode recommendations or auto-transitions
Do NOT add fake progress bars or optimistic UI
Do NOT use axios — fetch is sufficient
Do NOT add analytics, telemetry, or tracking
Do NOT soften error messages — be honest and direct
Do NOT add gradients, animations (except loading), or decorative elements
ALL SSE events must be captured in receipt cache even if not displayed
CODING mode exports require explicit operator confirmation before sending
EoHD button must be disabled until timeline upload is implemented

testing.coding_test: curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/coding -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"note":"62F chest pain dyspnea","limit":60}'

security.email_verification: Required for registration. Tokens expire in 30 minutes.
security.security_middleware: Blocks /.env, /.git, and common scan paths with 403
security.hipaa_note: No PHI stored without explicit consent. System is HIPAA-forward, not yet HIPAA-certified.
